text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lunch break. I saw Bubble Gum Fellow
surrounded by friends, lively playing a board game.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Use the 'Aptitude Card' to switch to dirt.
Move forward 6 spaces—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
...Yay♪
Won the race, plus 10,000 points!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Haha, bold move, Laurel.
Guess I'm up next. I rolled a 3, so—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
"...No way, 'Overslept'!?
'Failed to make it in time for the race',
so minus 20,000 points...!?"
choice_data_list: Hey, what are you up to?
Hey, what are you up to?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ah, 'Umamusume: The Game of Life'!
You experience races and events while collecting points,
aiming to become the "Ultimate Umamusume of Life."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
1, 2, 3, 4...
"Ran out of stamina due to poor conditioning"?
Nngh... I lost points again.
choice_data_list: Your dice rolls have been unlucky for a while now...
Your dice rolls have been unlucky for a while now...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, true that!
I'm in dead last right now, after all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Still, being at a disadvantage doesn't matter.
A path to victory is something you forge with your own hands, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hoh. Meaning?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
In this gameâI'm taking it all.
The title of 'Strongest Umamusume in Life' is mine!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"The collab ramen shop is a huge hit!"
Now, more and more bonus points
will be added every turn!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, I'll play 'Care Package' on Fine!
In exchange for 2,000 points from me,
you'll share your bonuses every turn!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Time for me to go on the offensive too—Image change with the "Costume Card"! Expanding my fan base and earning 10,000 points.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll play my 'Co-Star Card'!
The UmaTok dance with Ikuno went viral,
earning us an extra 5,000 points!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Bubble-chan is closing the gap!
Aggressively pushing forward even in a disadvantageous spot, that's our girl!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph. True enough... For all their bold talk, they certainly know the right moment to make a move.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Bubble Gum Fellow's charge wouldn't stop.
Little by little—no, steadily—
the gap was closing. And then...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
1, 2, 3...
Ah――a Challenge Space!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
"Big Live Event"...!
Roll the dice: if it's even, you gain 250,000 points; if it's odd, you lose 100,000 points!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Wah! If this concert goes well,
Bubble-san will make a comeback for 1st place!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
However, losing 100,000 points here would guarantee defeat.
Even if she passes the challenge, her current score
leaves first place well within reach, but...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—I'm glad.
To have a choice in how I make my move.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
There's a path to victory either way. If so,
I'll show you I can win no matter which route we take—because I'm me!
choice_data_list: Maybe we should play it safe and steady?

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—Chuckle.
I knew that is what you would say.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Here—I go on the attack and take the win! Take this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
The die rolls... a 6!?
The live is a huge success! Bubble-chan really is
so clutch when it counts...!
choice_data_list: You carved out that path to victory nicely!
You carved out that path to victory nicely, didn't you!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Right? I did declare that I'd claim
the title of "The Strongest Umamusume in History."
—Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sprinting straight through to the finish line—just as promised, Bubble Gum Fellow took a brilliant 1st-place victory!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
If I back down here, my rep as the vanguard is ruined!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Now—it's a showdown! Take that!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
The number is... 4!
Whoa, the live's a success!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright! With this, I'm in 1st place!
I'm gonna sprint straight through to the goal like this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bubble Gum Fellow rejoiced. But right after, on the space right before the goal—

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
What?!
"Pitfall Trap: Minus 50,000 points"?!
Uwah, not now of all times...!
choice_data_list: Even so, you locked in 2nd place—a fantastic effort!
Even so, you locked in 2nd place—a fantastic effort!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that was a fine late charge.
Hanging on and fighting back even at a disadvantage—
that is truly the stance of "one who reaches for the ideal."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you.
Still... I'm just not satisfied after all.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
So, I make this declaration.
Next time, I will definitely win!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: I knew it, that's right!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "I'm putting it all on this die! Ha!"

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: —...!! The roll was a 3, huh...
choice_data_list: It's an odd number, so minus 100,000 points...

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
The dice rolls just weren't on your side.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
“Still, ending it without going on the offensive wouldn’t be like me.
Even this kind of outcome feels like a game, which makes it fun!”

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
You're certainly right; even without taking unnecessary gambles,
we can forge a path to victory with our current momentum.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's skip this one! Just like before,
we'll keep steadily picking up points!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
—I did it!
Even if it was by a narrow margin...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"A solid offense and calm judgment—
I would love to learn from that myself."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: "Fufu. With every single move, I could feel the path "opening up."

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Seizing victory at the end of everything you've built up—
fighting like this isn't half bad!
